One front eye and four small round teeth exist on front only and are hidden behind the body from this rear view. Root arrangement is a coherent natural interpretation: two front legs, two side-rear legs, one rear-middle leg. Keep that same ring; do not create five feet by adding roots. The rear-middle leg that is centered nearest in image1 should shift toward SCREEN RIGHT in this NW view; the adjacent side leg is nearer SCREEN LEFT, forming the two nearer legs. Far front feet may be partly hidden beneath the body. Natural occlusion is preferred to forcing all five full legs visible. Preserve fur style, palette, face anatomy on hidden front and existing toe style. Keep the rear eye-free. Do not turn it into wood or add rings. Full creature centered, generous transparent margin, square canvas, no labels, no scenery, no ground shadow. This is a coherent adjacent-angle view of one individual, not a redesign.
